about: A ticket about a portal login and a slow laptop travels from the help desk through accounts and network experts to a hardware expert. Every agent runs on Anthropic.
how: Each agent either finishes or hands over with a note; here the ticket passed three handovers and the last agent finished.
learns: A handoff chain can pass work along without anybody solving all of it: the last expert here covers only the hardware part.
watch: The notes between the agents, and what the final answer leaves unsolved.
